sections.source_summary: Right-of-way for a person who is blind, on foot, and using a qualifying service animal or white or red-tipped cane; approaching drivers must yield and stop if necessary.
A driver must obey a school crossing guard's direction or signal and wait until the highway is clear of all persons.
